sentences.en: The embryos and fetuses of all mammals look quite similar.
sentences.zh: 所有哺乳动物的胚胎和胎儿看起来都很相似。

sentences.en: A developing embryo connects to the placenta via the umbilical cord.
sentences.zh: 发育中的胚胎通过脐带与胎盘相连。

sentences.en: The cloning of human embryos is prohibited by law.
sentences.zh: 克隆人类胚胎在法律上是被禁止的。
